abstract: We study lobbying as a seller's ploy to affect the buyer's learning process about the value of a singular good he wishes to procure. We argue that a lobbying seller strategically distorts “soft” rather than private information, and model this as the seller “jamming” the buyer's signal—not merely by shifting its mean, but also by skewing (increasing the third moment of) its distribution. An unobserved increase in lobbying effort always expands demand; thus, unless it is too costly, the seller lobbies regardless of how suspicious the buyer is. Crucially, even when correctly anticipated in equilibrium, lobbying rotates the buyer's demand in a way that lowers the equilibrium price and increases efficiency. In our skew‐normal learning model, the seller gains (gross of the cost of her lobbying effort) and the buyer loses from lobbying in equilibrium; nonetheless, the information gleaned in the process keeps the buyer from refusing to engage with the seller altogether.
title: The Art of Pitching: A Theory of Lobbying in Procurement
title_zh: 游说艺术：采购中的游说理论

abstract: This paper examines the USDA strategy to restructure US beef packing to increase competition and resilience by supporting the entry of small processors. Unlike previous studies that impose or calibrate conduct or assume symmetry between entrants and incumbents, we develop and estimate an asymmetric structural dominant‐oligopsony/oligopoly competitive‐fringe model using 1987–2022 data and IV‐GMM, allowing dominant packer conduct to respond to fringe entry. Findings indicate that fringe packer entry increases, rather than decreases, dominant packers' market power—widening price spreads and raising profits at the expense of consumers and farmers—without meaningfully improving resilience. The counterintuitive link between dominant market power and fringe entry arises because, in addition to being cost‐disadvantaged, the fringe group bids up cattle prices by shifting demand, eroding its ability to influence the residual market and enabling the dominant group to exercise greater market power.
title: Market and Welfare Effects of Restructuring US Beef Packing for Competition and Resilience
title_zh: 美国牛肉加工重组对竞争与韧性的市场与福利效应

abstract: This paper replicates and extends the evidence on the lifetime effects of school starting age on earnings by Fredriksson and Öckert (2014) for Sweden. Using German data for individuals born between 1945 and 1965, we examine a more rigid system of ability tracking in secondary education, a potential driver of long‐term effects. We confirm negligible effects of later school entry for men and positive effects for women. These gender differences arise despite similar effects on educational attainment. By unfolding the gender gaps over the lifecycle, assessing fertility decisions, and maternal employment around the first birth, we show that childbirth postponement and increased labor market attachment after the first birth seem to be plausible mechanisms.
title: School Starting Age and the Gender Pay Gap Over the Life Cycle
title_zh: 入学年龄与生命周期中的性别薪酬差距

abstract: This study examined how foreign direct investment (FDI) in services is affected by regional trade agreement (RTA)‐induced policy uncertainty (i.e., second‐moment uncertainty shocks), which is separated from first‐moment shocks. Policy uncertainty is elicited by examining two different types of reservations regarding certain RTA obligations: current and future reservations. Examining these reservations allowed us to capture the different magnitudes and timing of shocks. Using affiliate‐level data, we evaluated how the activities of foreign affiliates of Japanese multinational enterprises are affected by Japan's RTAs with host country‐sector‐reservation level commitments such as market access (MA), national treatment (NT) and the most favoured nation (MFN) signed by Japan from 1995 to 2018. We found that a reduction in PU regarding the current reservation of MA increases the ownership ratio of parent firms. We also found that a reduction in PU regarding the current and future reservation in MFN, together with MA, encourages the establishment of foreign affiliates. Consistent with our conceptual framework, our results show that the magnitude of PU in future reservations is considerably larger for affiliate entry than that in current reservations. Our results also highlight the difference in timing between current and future reservations.
title: The Impact of Policy Uncertainty on Foreign Direct Investment in Services: Evidence From Affiliate‐Level Data and the Role of Regional Trade Agreements
title_zh: 政策不确定性对服务业外商直接投资的影响：基于附属机构层面数据的证据及区域贸易协定的作用

abstract: Executive compensation design is central to corporate governance. Pay contracts may shape managers’ incentives to undertake investments with delayed returns. This paper analyzes how the equity-based and long-term component of CEO compensation relates to strategic investment, productivity, and operating performance among U.S. public firms covered by Compustat and ExecuComp over 1992–2017. We estimate a recursive generalized structural equation model linking the share of equity-based and long-term compensation (EB-LT) to R&D expenditure, advertising expenditure, Levinsohn–Petrin total factor productivity, and EBITDA, and examine CEO firm-specific tenure as a moderator. A 10-percentage-point higher EB-LT share is associated with 11.4% higher R&D spending and 8.9% higher advertising spending. R&D and advertising are, in turn, strongly related to productivity, and productivity is positively related to EBITDA. The findings identify a structured compensation–investment–productivity–performance nexus in which EB-LT compensation is most consistently connected to strategic investment channels. They also suggest that equity-based incentive design should be evaluated jointly with firms’ investment strategies, productivity outcomes, and CEO tenure profiles, rather than viewed in isolation as a mechanism for improving productivity or profits.
title: Executive compensation, strategic investment, productivity, and firm performance
title_zh: 高管薪酬、战略投资、生产率与企业绩效

abstract: This study examines whether the marginal effects of leverage on firm performance vary across post-reform lifecycle stages and market structures. Using 794 firm-year observations from 40 Malaysian firms with documented privatization and state-linked corporate reform histories over 2000–2024, the study applies firm and year fixed-effects models. The findings show that the leverage-performance relationship is heterogeneous rather than uniform. However, there is no general evidence of the nonlinear balancing relationship predicted by trade-off theory, while evidence of lifecycle heterogeneity is limited. The strongest heterogeneity emerges across market structures, with competitive firms experiencing greater leverage-related profitability pressure than regulated firms. Results from a range of sensitivity and robustness checks largely preserve the main findings. From a policy perspective, the findings support a risk-based and lifecycle-sensitive approach to capital structure that accounts for firms’ competitive exposure, financial resilience and debt servicing capacity, particularly in regulated firms in which government retains an ownership stake or remains financially exposed.
title: Debt discipline after privatization: lifecycle and market-structure evidence from Malaysia
title_zh: 私有化后的债务约束：来自马来西亚的生命周期与市场结构证据

abstract: Public investment reallocates both resources and expectations. This study examines this dual role through China’s local government special bonds, a project-based fiscal instrument that reveals local governments’ green development priorities through observable and spatially targeted spending commitments. We construct a novel dataset of 146,601 special bond projects from 2019 to 2024, identify county-level allocations to the new-energy sector, and match them with Chinese A-share listed firms. We find that new-energy special bond allocation significantly increases corporate green innovation. The result is robust to alternative measures, Tobit estimation, winsorization, placebo tests using non-green patents, dynamic DID analysis, Bartik instrumental variables, propensity score matching, and entropy balancing. Mechanism tests show that corporate climate risk attention, measured from annual reports, partially mediates the effect, suggesting that targeted public investment guides managerial attention in addition to supplying capital. The effect is stronger where policy signals are more credible or easier to absorb, including regions with developed venture capital markets, carbon pilot cities, and projects using bond funds as capital. Executive green background further strengthens firms’ innovation response. These findings show how place-based public investment transforms fiscal allocation into corporate climate cognition and green innovation.

title: When public money speaks: local government special bonds and corporate green innovation in China
title_zh: 当公共资金发声：中国政府专项债券与企业绿色创新

abstract: International oil price fluctuations are an important source of external inflation pressure, but their domestic effects vary across economies depending on exposure to imported energy costs. This study examines whether energy dependence systematically explains heterogeneous inflation responses to global oil price movements, using an unbalanced annual panel of 72 countries from 2001 to 2023. Employing dynamic two-way fixed effects models with country and year effects, we identify differential transmission via the interaction between global oil price growth and lagged energy dependence. The results show that countries with higher prior energy dependence exhibit stronger differential consumer price index (CPI) responses to the same global oil price shock. These findings remain robust to alternative inflation measures, positive oil price movements, predetermined energy exposure, exclusion of major events and dynamic panel estimation. Additional evidence supports an external cost transmission channel through import prices, though we interpret this as supportive rather than a structural causal decomposition. Overall, the findings call for incorporating energy dependence and import price pressure into inflation monitoring and risk assessment.
title: Energy dependence and the differential pass-through of oil price shocks to inflation: evidence from 72 countries
title_zh: 能源依赖与油价冲击对通胀的差异化传导：来自72个国家的证据

abstract: As power systems increasingly rely on renewable energy generation and accommodate flexible loads, understanding short-term demand flexibility becomes essential. Denmark provides a particularly relevant setting with a high share of variable renewable generation and widespread electric vehicle (EV) adoption. Using hourly charging session data from approximately 5000 residential charging stations over the span of more than three years, this study provides extensive evidence on the very short-term price elasticity for demand of residential EV charging. As a benchmark, we compare this estimate with the short-term price elasticity of general household electricity consumption among Danish households. Employing an instrumental variable approach based on exogenous wind and solar power generation, we estimate substantial responsiveness of EV charging to hourly electricity prices. We estimate a price elasticity of demand of –0.756 for residential EV charging, compared with –0.062 for general household electricity consumption, highlighting the flexible nature of EV charging. Users shift charging toward hours with lower electricity prices, a behaviour that intensified during the 2022 energy crisis and persisted after prices returned to stable levels. The evidence supports dynamic pricing as a tool to unlock short-horizon flexibility, while highlighting the risk of synchronized charging peaks with increased EV adoption.
abstract_zh: 随着电力系统日益依赖可再生能源发电并接纳灵活性负荷，理解短期需求灵活性变得至关重要。丹麦提供了一个尤为相关的研究背景，其具有高比例的可变可再生能源发电和广泛的电动汽车（EV）普及。本研究利用约5000个住宅充电站三年多的小时级充电会话数据，为住宅电动汽车充电需求的极短期价格弹性提供了大量证据。作为基准，我们将该估计值与丹麦家庭一般电力消费的短期价格弹性进行比较。采用基于外生风能和太阳能发电的工具变量方法，我们估计电动汽车充电对小时级电价具有显著响应。我们估计住宅电动汽车充电的需求价格弹性为–0.756，而一般家庭电力消费为–0.062，凸显了电动汽车充电的灵活性特征。用户将充电转移至电价较低的时段，这一行为在2022年能源危机期间加剧，并在价格恢复至稳定水平后持续存在。这些证据支持动态定价作为释放短时间尺度灵活性的工具，同时凸显了随着电动汽车普及而出现同步充电高峰的风险。
title: On the price elasticity of residential electric vehicle charging in Denmark
title_zh: 丹麦住宅电动汽车充电的价格弹性

abstract: Selecting a committee of size k from a set of candidates involves a delicate balance between maximizing individual excellence and ensuring group compatibility. Recent literature has proposed the k-Shapley value-based committee rule (Dutta et al. 2024), which leverages cooperative game theory to aggregate voters’ approvals of various candidate coalitions into a characteristic function. By selecting candidates with the top-k highest Shapley values, the rule attempts to capture average marginal contributions. In this paper, we build upon this framework by identifying the analytical boundary where candidate-wise aggregation diverges from specific group compatibility. We introduce the “Compatibility Paradox,” demonstrating that because the Shapley value aggregates marginal contributions across all possible subsets, it can occasionally prescribe a committee that voters consider strictly incompatible. We formalize this tension through two impossibility results: first, as an elementary observation that no committee-monotone rule can universally avoid this paradox, and second, as a broader mathematical constraint applicable to any positive weight system (including all regular semivalues). Finally, we propose a constructive remedy, delineating the division of labor between Shapley-based individual scoring and committee-wise evaluation to resolve the paradox.
abstract_zh: 从候选集合中选出规模为k的委员会，需要在最大化个体卓越性与确保群体兼容性之间取得微妙平衡。近期文献提出了基于k-Shapley值的委员会规则（Dutta等，2024），该规则利用合作博弈论将选民对不同候选人联盟的认可聚合为一个特征函数。通过选择Shapley值最高的前k名候选人，该规则试图捕捉平均边际贡献。本文在该框架基础上，识别出候选人逐项聚合与特定群体兼容性发生偏离的分析边界。我们引入“兼容性悖论”，表明由于Shapley值聚合了所有可能子集上的边际贡献，它有时会指定一个被选民视为严格不兼容的委员会。我们通过两个不可能性结果将这一张力形式化：第一，作为一个基本观察，即不存在任何委员会单调规则能够普遍避免这一悖论；第二，作为一个适用于任何正权重系统（包括所有正则半值）的更广泛数学约束。最后，我们提出一种建设性补救方案，界定基于Shapley的个体评分与委员会层面评估之间的分工，以解决该悖论。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Compatibility paradox: impossibilities in Shapley-based committee selection
title_zh: 兼容性悖论：基于沙普利的委员会选择中的不可能性

abstract: This study develops a model of multi-product firms (MPFs) to examine their responses to power outages and the consequent effects on firm productivity. In the model, MPFs mitigate the adverse effects of power outages by discontinuing their less-productive products and focusing more on their core varieties. This buffering mechanism, however, comes at the cost of reduced product variety and a more concentrated product mix. We test this theory using firm–product-level export data from the Chinese metals and articles thereof industry from 2005 to 2015, combined with a text-based power outage index. Consistent with the model’s predictions, we find that a 1% increase in power outages reduces the productivity of single-product firms (SPFs) by 0.43%. MPFs experience a 0.31% smaller decline in productivity; however, this comes at the expense of a 0.20% reduction in product variety within these firms. We further calibrate the model and show that a 1% reduction in the observed 2005 outage level raises aggregate welfare by 0.017%, of which more than one-third is driven by MPF-specific within-firm reallocation and variety recovery. Our theory reconciles the findings on the impacts of power outages across countries, underscoring the critical role of the intra-firm extensive margin in economic loss assessments.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个多产品企业（MPFs）模型，以考察其对停电的响应以及由此对企业生产率产生的影响。在该模型中，多产品企业通过停产生产率较低的产品并更加专注于其核心产品种类，来缓解停电带来的不利影响。然而，这种缓冲机制以产品种类减少和产品组合更加集中为代价。我们使用2005年至2015年中国金属及其制品行业的企业—产品层面出口数据，结合基于文本的停电指数，对该理论进行了检验。与模型预测一致，我们发现停电每增加1%，单产品企业（SPFs）的生产率下降0.43%。多产品企业的生产率降幅小0.31个百分点；然而，这是以这些企业内部产品种类减少0.20%为代价的。我们进一步对模型进行校准，并表明，将2005年观测到的停电水平降低1%，会使总福利提高0.017%，其中超过三分之一由多产品企业特有的企业内再配置和产品种类恢复所驱动。我们的理论调和了关于停电影响的跨国研究发现，凸显了企业内扩展边际在经济损失评估中的关键作用。
